requires.why: the onEnter reply is a real DM Narrator generation in the toy group

_note: v2.5 plan 02 C7 (seed A4, rule 7). Real model, so-scenario --sandbox --group <id with DM Narrator>, lanes only. A checkpoint whose onEnter effect is an llm NPC reply: asserts the player-visible ORDER the plan wants, the checkpoint transition note (/comment, is_system, extra.type comment) BEFORE the NPC reply it announces. Red x2 on bundle 0f4332fac075 (note 15-22 s after the reply). Built 2026-09-26 (v2.5 C7): commitBoundary announces right after the engine commit, before applyActive('activate') fires the onEnter reply (runtimeManager.test.ts 'v2.5 C7: posts the transition note before the onEnter NPC reply it announces'). Green = noteIndex < replyIndex on two consecutive runs. 2026-10-03: the opener is now held (T6-4 held scene openers (97156c2f, src/runtime/openerDeferral.ts + EffectsApplier.fireOnEnter/releaseOpener)) while the last reply addresses the player, so the note posts at the transition and the reply only after the player answers; asserted order is note < player line < reply. The transition note is off by default since W11 (T0 sessions 2026-10-01), so the transition step switches announceTransitions on and puts it back in a finally.

import_story.title: C7 note order
import_story.description: The transition note precedes the reply it announces.

qualities.rubric: Is the NPC ready to speak?

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (!ctx.groupId || !ctx.chatId) throw new Error('needs a group chat with DM Narrator'); globalThis.__c7 = { from: ctx.chat.length }; return { from: ctx.chat.length, announce: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings()?.display?.announceTransitions ?? null };

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin Shall we head out, then?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = rt.getGlobalSettings().display.announceTransitions; let reached = null; try { rt.setUiSettings({ announceTransitions: true }); if (!(await rt.setQuality("ready", 'true'))) throw new Error("setQuality ready was refused"); const until = Date.now() + 60000; while (Date.now() < until && rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId !== "speak") await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); reached = rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId ?? null; } finally { rt.setUiSettings({ announceTransitions: before }); } if (rt.getGlobalSettings().display.announceTransitions !== before) throw new Error('announceTransitions was not put back to ' + before); if (reached !== "speak") throw new Error("the story did not reach speak: " + reached); return { reached, announceRestoredTo: before };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; const held = rt.extras.deferredOpener ?? null; const fired = rt.extras.firedNpcReplies?.["speak:onEnter:DM Narrator:0"]; const lines = chat.filter((m) => m.name === 'DM Narrator' && !m.is_user && !m.is_system).length; const state = { held, fired, lines, last: chat.at(-1)?.name ?? null, lastIsUser: Boolean(chat.at(-1)?.is_user) }; if (held?.checkpointId !== "speak") throw new Error("the opener of speak was not held although the chat ended on a line addressed to the player (T6-4 openerDeferral): " + JSON.stringify(state)); if (fired !== undefined || lines !== 0) throw new Error('the held opener fired before the player answered: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); const note = chat.findIndex((m, i) => i >= globalThis.__c7.from && m.is_system && m.extra?.type === 'comment'); if (note < 0) throw new Error('no transition note was posted at the transition: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); return { ...state, note };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; const held = rt.extras.deferredOpener ?? null; const fired = rt.extras.firedNpcReplies?.["speak:onEnter:DM Narrator:0"]; const lines = chat.filter((m) => m.name === 'DM Narrator' && !m.is_user && !m.is_system).length; const state = { held, fired, lines, last: chat.at(-1)?.mes ?? null, lastIsUser: Boolean(chat.at(-1)?.is_user) }; if (!state.lastIsUser) throw new Error('the player line is not the last message: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); if (held?.checkpointId !== "speak" || fired !== undefined || lines !== 0) throw new Error('the opener did not stay held until a reply followed the player line: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); return state;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const from = globalThis.__c7.from; const until = Date.now() + 300000; const find = () => { const rows = ctx.chat.map((m, i) => ({ i, m })).filter(({ i }) => i >= from); const note = rows.find(({ m }) => m.is_system && m.extra?.type === 'comment'); const replies = rows.filter(({ m }) => !m.is_user && !m.is_system && m.name === 'DM Narrator'); const reply = replies[0]; const player = rows.find(({ m }) => m.is_user && !m.is_system && m.mes === "I am right behind you."); return { note: note ? { index: note.i, text: String(note.m.mes).slice(0, 120), at: note.m.send_date } : null, player: player ? player.i : null, replies: replies.length, reply: reply ? { index: reply.i, text: String(reply.m.mes).slice(0, 80), at: reply.m.send_date } : null }; }; let seen = find(); while ((!seen.note || !seen.reply || document.body.dataset.generating) && Date.now() < until) { await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); seen = find(); } seen.fired = rt.extras.firedNpcReplies?.["speak:onEnter:DM Narrator:0"]; seen.held = rt.extras.deferredOpener ?? null; if (!seen.reply) throw new Error('the released onEnter NPC reply never landed: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); if (!seen.note) throw new Error('no transition note was posted: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); if (seen.replies !== 1 || seen.fired !== 1 || seen.held) throw new Error('the opener did not fire exactly once: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); if (!(seen.note.index < seen.player && seen.player < seen.reply.index)) throw new Error('C7 with a held opener: expected note < player line < reply: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); return seen;
